received_works.body:
カランkaran先生、初めまして。
My name is PULS4RRRR, an electronic music composer.
I would like to commission an single release artwork design.

[Main Request]
1. Main theme: Game, 8-bit
2. A girl character with a energetic, troublemaker-like vibe
3. Desired artwork size: A square format of 2000 × 2000 or larger

[Preferred Elements]
1. Purple or sky blue based color
2. Band-aid
3. ドヤ顔 expression
4. Neko-mimi headset
5. The background can be anything as long as it fits the character.
*If you think it doesn't suit you too much, you can exclude it.

[Usage]
The artwork will be used as EP or ingle release art, and depending on the situation, a title may be added to the bottom of the artwork.

I enjoy viewing your works on Pixiv. I would be truly grateful if you could accept this commission. Thank you very much!

Best regards,
PULS4RRRR
